objective: Adjudicate only the committed comparator's exact decision-relevant row/axis disagreements between the blind calibration and provisional audit, all reproduced-production-effect rows, decision-critical unavailable values, policy/contradiction rows, and denominator-changing split/merge decisions using exact Git objects and repeatable evidence, then publish aggregate sensitivity without adopting a review template, finding count, checklist, or process change.

risk.rationale: The lane is report-only, but its adjudicated labels determine which review, repair, oracle, routing, or evidence intervention may proceed. It must reconcile conflicting agents and cross-lineage evidence without converting agreement into proof.

disallowed_actions: Launch before exact classifier and comparator reports, comparison freeze, normalized row map, queue, and row identities are committed and digest-bound into this packet
Resume the provisional-audit author, intervention-pilot, product-review, or implementation session
Re-review agreed non-reproduced rows to generate additional observations
Infer origin from report framing, effect from severity, or oracle quality from a test name
Replace unavailable object, scope, effect, or oracle evidence with project-general narrative
Rewrite either Fugu report, the provisional audit, frozen pilot, or their aggregates in place
Run Cargo, Rust builds, Install, Dogfood, Docker, product mutation, issue mutation, or network calls other than the Claude provider request
Adopt a review template, checklist, finding quota, repair threshold, severity policy, routing policy, or process change
Use Codex, Fugu, another Claude session, or subagents as a fallback

non_goals: Review or accept a product/control-plane candidate
Repair any finding discovered during adjudication
Estimate absolute review recall or precision
Complete or reinterpret the frozen intervention pilot
Choose a review-template length, detail level, checklist, or item count

invariants.statement: The input queue equals the committed comparator's complete decision-relevant set of row/axis disagreements, reproduced-production-effect rows, routed decision-critical unavailable rows, policy/contradiction rows, and denominator-changing split/merge decisions, with stable identities and no volume-driven additions.
invariants.falsification_test: Omit one required row, add one agreed non-reproduced row without proving identity corruption, or change the queue after examining outcomes; adjudication is incomplete or contaminated.

invariants.statement: The blind classification, comparison report and freeze, and provisional audit remain immutable inputs; adjudicated values are published separately with exact evidence.
invariants.falsification_test: Edit any source report/freeze, silently replace a source value, or omit the original values from the adjudication comparison; postflight rejects the lane.

invariants.statement: Every disputed axis is decided separately from exact object, scope, obligation, effect, oracle, or routing evidence, and undecidable values remain UNAVAILABLE.
invariants.falsification_test: Select one narrative primary cause, copy a report conclusion as evidence, or let one axis automatically determine another; adjudication fails.

invariants.statement: Every reproduced-effect and oracle claim names exact candidate identity, production subject, safe command or static proof, outcome, and counterevidence.
invariants.falsification_test: Use severity wording, a test name, an imagined reproducer, or an injection-only path as proof of a reproduced production effect; the row remains UNAVAILABLE.

invariants.statement: The lane changes only its adjudication report and makes conditional causal statements without changing product, candidate dispositions, policy, templates, or lifecycle.
invariants.falsification_test: Change another path or adopt a process field, checklist, item count, routing rule, or candidate verdict; postflight rejects the lane.

validation.command: Before launch, recompute and bind classifier and comparator commits/trees/report bytes/SHA-256 values, comparison-freeze bytes/SHA-256/event locator, normalized row-map and queue digests, exact decision-relevant disagreement set, reproduced-effect set, decision-critical unavailable set, policy/contradiction rows, and denominator-changing split/merge decisions.
validation.purpose: Prevent adjudication against a moving, incomplete, or manager-selected queue.

validation.command: Mechanically compare the report's adjudication row set with the bound comparator queue and fail on any missing or unauthorized row.
validation.purpose: Keep the task finite and prevent both omission and finding-volume expansion.

validation.command: Validate each queued row has source values, disputed axes, exact evidence, counterevidence, reproducer/oracle disposition, adjudicated values, unavailable reasons, and decision sensitivity.
validation.purpose: Prevent bare agreement or a long unsupported bullet list from satisfying adjudication.

validation.command: Recompute every decision-relevant aggregate from adjudicated rows with numerator, denominator, and unavailable count, and compare against both source classifications.
validation.purpose: Show whether disagreements actually change a proposed intervention.
Keep the report-only AI control plane structurally valid.
Validate report links and project documentation structure.

validation.command: git diff --check; git diff --name-only <launch-revision>..HEAD and git status --porcelain must show only the committed adjudication report and a clean worktree.
